name: Sora Shizuka
source: Kenichi's childhood best friend and the only lasting connection he's ever had. He is smart, kind, sweet, and deeply empathetic, though he tends to worry a little too much about things. Sora constantly seeks to spend time with Kenichi. Surprisingly, Kenichi doesn't seem bothered by this behavior. Sora also has a tendency to challenge Kenichi and encourage him to reflect on his thoughts and beliefs. He often does this by asking cryptic questions or bringing up philosophical concepts, sometimes making his speech rather contusing or difficult to follow.
